purpose: Test whether species-specific wet-versus-dry recruitment heterogeneity persists after pair-level temperature, survey-date, rain-contrast magnitude, and year-gap differences are accounted for.

species_family.rule: No species added or removed based on adjusted results.

event_data.unit: species × matched-run pair for pairs where that species is present in exactly one member
event_data.response: 1 = species present only in wetter run; 0 = species present only in drier run

model.per_species: Binomial-logit GLM y ~ centered_rain_contrast + centered_temp_difference + centered_doy_difference + centered_year_gap
model.centering: Center each covariate within species over its discordant events; intercept therefore estimates adjusted wet-vs-dry log odds at that species' mean pair conditions.
model.failure_rule: If model fails or intercept/SE is nonfinite, species is retained in raw family but marked adjusted_nonestimable.

multiple_testing: BH FDR across estimable species intercept tests.

heterogeneity.statistic: inverse-variance Cochran Q across estimable adjusted species intercepts
heterogeneity.purpose: test residual species heterogeneity after pair-level covariate adjustment

concordance.metric: Spearman correlation between raw Haldane wet-vs-dry log odds and adjusted intercept log odds among estimable species
concordance.purpose: quantify whether raw species ranking survives adjustment

boundary: Adjustment is robustness, not a new primary species-selection family.
No trait values enter this analysis.
